statements.status_notes: The advisory names lodash.template as the affected function. The application imports lodash and calls template at src/render/email.js:47 and :92. The call at :47 is reachable from the postWelcome route handler via sendWelcome and renderWelcomeEmail; no path resolved for :92, which changes nothing. Upgrade to 4.17.21.

No usage evidence found within the analysed scope. The application calls axios.get, but neither candidate symbol (isURLSameOrigin, redirect) appears in application code. One computed member access on axios at src/api/dispatch.js:24 could not be resolved, and code inside dependencies is not analysed. This is not proof of safety.

Could not determine which function this advisory implicates, so no usage comparison was possible. Prototype pollution affects argument parsing generally. Treated at package level; a critical severity with no determination should be reviewed manually.

The vulnerable function defaultsDeep was identified with high confidence, but this lodash 3.10.1 is installed under legacy-reporter. Component 2 reported the occurrence as unanalysed because any call would originate inside legacy-reporter, and SBOMber analyses application source only. This cannot be determined either way.
